"""One ASAN+UBSAN validation of the exact frozen native-core source."""
import hashlib,json,os,pathlib,platform,re,subprocess,sys,sysconfig,unittest

class NativeCoreSanitizerJob(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_frozen_native_core(self):
        root=pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]/"sanitizer"
        expected=json.loads((root/"inventory.json").read_text())
        manifest={}
        def digest(data):
            return {"bytes":len(data),"sha256":hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),
                    "git_blob_sha1":hashlib.sha1(b"blob "+str(len(data)).encode()+b"\0"+data).hexdigest()}
        for name,sha in expected["files"].items():
            value=digest((root/name).read_bytes())
            self.assertEqual(value["git_blob_sha1"],sha,name)
            manifest[name]=value
        compiler=subprocess.check_output(["gcc","--version"],text=True).splitlines()[0]
        native=root/"src/memory_book"
        binary=native/("_native"+sysconfig.get_config_var("EXT_SUFFIX"))
        build_command=["gcc","-shared","-fPIC","-O1","-g","-Wall","-Wextra","-fwrapv",
                       "-fno-omit-frame-pointer","-fsanitize=address,undefined","-fno-sanitize-recover=all",
                       "-I"+sysconfig.get_paths()["include"],str(native/"_native.c"),"-o",str(binary)]
        build=subprocess.run(build_command,cwd=root,text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=120)
        print("SANITIZER_BUILD_EXIT",build.returncode,flush=True)
        if build.stderr:print(build.stderr,flush=True)
        self.assertEqual(build.returncode,0,build.stderr)
        asan=subprocess.check_output(["gcc","-print-file-name=libasan.so"],text=True).strip()
        environment=dict(os.environ,PYTHONPATH=str(root/"src"),PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE="1",
                         PYTHONMALLOC="malloc",MEMORY_BOOK_TEXT_BACKEND="native",LD_PRELOAD=asan,
                         ASAN_OPTIONS="detect_leaks=0:abort_on_error=1:strict_string_checks=1",
                         UBSAN_OPTIONS="print_stacktrace=1:halt_on_error=1")
        command=[sys.executable,"-m","unittest","discover","-s","tests","-p","test_native*backend.py"]
        run=subprocess.run(command,cwd=root,env=environment,text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=240)
        print("SANITIZER_TEST_EXIT",run.returncode,flush=True)
        print(run.stdout,flush=True)
        print(run.stderr,flush=True)
        count=re.search(r"Ran (\d+) tests in ([\d.]+)s",run.stderr)
        report={"schema":"native-core-sanitizer-v1","repository":"Afloat16/AI-Memory-Book",
                "commit":expected["commit"],"source_files":manifest,
                "environment":{"python":sys.version,"platform":platform.platform(),"machine":platform.machine(),
                               "compiler":compiler,"asan_library":asan,
                               "runtime_variables":{key:environment[key] for key in
                                                    ("PYTHONPATH","PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE","PYTHONMALLOC",
                                                     "MEMORY_BOOK_TEXT_BACKEND","LD_PRELOAD","ASAN_OPTIONS","UBSAN_OPTIONS")}},
                "build":{"command":build_command,"exit_code":build.returncode,
                         "stdout":build.stdout,"stderr":build.stderr},
                "tests":{"command":command,"exit_code":run.returncode,"stdout":run.stdout,"stderr":run.stderr,
                         "methods":int(count.group(1)) if count else None,
                         "reported_elapsed_seconds":float(count.group(2)) if count else None,
                         "suites":sorted(path.name for path in (root/"tests").glob("test_native*backend.py"))},
                "binary":{"path":str(binary.relative_to(root)),**digest(binary.read_bytes())},
                "runner":{"path":pathlib.Path(__file__).name,**digest(pathlib.Path(__file__).read_bytes()),
                          "source":pathlib.Path(__file__).read_text()},
                "limitations":["CPython and system SQLite are not themselves sanitizer builds.",
                               "Leak detection is disabled for the embedding CPython process; native memory access and undefined-behavior checks are enabled.",
                               "This is correctness instrumentation, not a performance measurement."]}
        (root/"sanitizer-receipt.json").write_text(json.dumps(report,sort_keys=True,indent=2)+"\n")
        print("SANITIZER_RECEIPT_JSON="+json.dumps(report,sort_keys=True),flush=True)
        self.assertEqual(run.returncode,0,run.stderr)
        self.assertNotIn("ERROR: AddressSanitizer",run.stderr)
        self.assertNotIn("runtime error:",run.stderr)
